request.style: English, female solo vocal, warm and comforting, piano, acoustic guitar, strings, soft drums, hopeful and serene, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
So there is now no condemnation
For those who are in Christ Jesus
The law of the Spirit of life
Has set you free from sin

[Chorus]
No condemnation, no condemnation
In Christ Jesus we are free
The Spirit brings the law of life
And sets our souls at rest

[Verse]
What the law could not do weak
God did in his own Son
Sent in likeness of sinful flesh
As a sin offering
He condemned sin in the flesh
So the law is fulfilled in us
We walk not by the flesh
But according to the Spirit

[Chorus]
No condemnation, no condemnation
In Christ Jesus we are free
The Spirit brings the law of life
And sets our souls at rest

[Bridge]
Those who live by the flesh
Set minds on what is flesh
But those who live by the Spirit
Set minds on what is Spirit

[Outro]
So there is now no condemnation
For those who are in Christ Jesus
